thread:
maria: Heads up — post-launch tidy plan for the landing + webinar funnel. Need a short playbook for sitemap cleanup, canonical stitching, and inbound lead routing. Can we sketch tasks?
jordan: Yep. Prefer short checklist we can hand to PM and growth. Key goals: fix redirects, ensure schema for webinar pages, and map lead routing to CRM flows.
maria: Exact. Also want a one-paragraph benchmark narrative for the launch post to use in the webinar intro and sales snippets. Low-friction.
ash?: (note) I'm ash btw — I'll own redirects and internal link heatmap. Quick Q: do we keep legacy /academy URLs?
ash?: Suggestion: temporary 302s for 2 weeks then 301s after verification.
jordan: @ash +1 on 302 staging. @pete can you validate redirect list against crawl logs?
pete: I can pull crawl + GA pageseries. Will upload CSV to the doc by EOD.
maria: Great — doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1X_postlaunch-playbook (please comment in the doc, not here)
jordan: For schema: we need FAQ + Event schema for the webinar page, and breadcrumb/schema for the landing. Also add structured data for speaker names so search shows in SERP.
ash?: I'll paste a minimal JSON-LD snippet for the webinar page. Use it as a baseline.
ash?: ````json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference: Post-launch benchmarks & playbook",
  "startDate": "2024-05-10T16:00:00Z",
  "location": { "@type": "VirtualLocation", "url": "https://redwood.ai/webinar" },
  "performer": [{ "@type": "Person", "name": "Maria Lopez" }],
  "description": "Rapid post-launch benchmarks, canonical stitching, and inbound lead routing."
}
````
maria: Nice. Keep startDate as variable (we'll update). Also we should add "potentialAction" snippet for registration CTA so Google surfaces register link.
jordan: On internal linking: critical pages get the highest link depth and clear canonical. @ash can run a heatmap and propose 10 internal anchors for the launch post and webinar hub.
ash?: Will do. Plan: run Ahrefs internal link export + site crawl, then surface top 10 anchor targets. Aim to reduce click depth to <=3 for priority pages.
pete: CRM routing: mapping needed. For each gated asset, map form -> utm -> lead route -> sales queue. I'll draft a mapping table.
maria: For the benchmark narrative: short template — 3 bullets: 1) what we measured (latency/cost/user-facing metrics), 2) top 3 wins (e.g., 30% faster token time), 3) next steps + call to action (sign up/webinar). Can someone draft?
jordan: I can do a 2-paragraph draft by tomorrow morning.
seo-bot: Automated crawl report ready: /reports/postlaunch-crawl-1738801234.csv (uploaded). Issues found: 12 duplicate titles, 7 missing breadcrumbs, 4 5xx after launch.
maria: Thanks @seo-bot — @ash can you triage 5xx and missing breadcrumbs first? Prioritize pages linked from the webinar hub.
ash?: On it. I'll mark blocking ones in the doc.
pete: Also: redirect moratorium window — suggestion: freeze non-critical redirects for 72h after push to avoid search volatility. Thoughts?
jordan: Agree. Add to playbook: "Redirect moratorium: no global redirect roll until 72h post-publication unless P0".
maria: Final ask: someone add a short lead routing test plan (smoke tests). Steps: submit test leads with utm variants, confirm CRM assignment, and check webhook latency < 5s. @pete?
pete: I'll own the smoke test and share results in the doc.
maria: Perfect. Timeline: today — crawl + redirect list (pete/ash); schema draft (ash); internal anchors (ash); benchmark draft (jordan) by tomorrow AM; smoke test (pete) after deploy.
jordan: I'll update the doc with the checklist and add an owner column.
maria: Thanks team. One more: add a short snippet for the webinar registration meta description (under 160 chars). I'll draft and drop it in the doc.
seo-bot: Reminder scheduled: I'll ping this thread at +48h to check redirect status. :robot_face:
